body.statement: For every \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), the spectrally clipped feasible construction satisfies \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\mathbf P\in\mathfrak M}\Pr_{\mathbb P_n}\{\tau_n\in C_n^{\mathrm{proj}}(\alpha)\}\ge1-\alpha\). The infimum ranges over the full exact-close triangular-array class, including fixed and \(n^{-1/2}\)-local score separations, every covariance array satisfying the eigenvalue bounds, unequal stable group sizes, and every multiple-close-donor face.
body.justification: The result gives a feasible honest baseline that propagates score uncertainty, post-outcome uncertainty, and dependence across labels in one inversion.
body.gap: Berk et al. establish generic simultaneous post-selection coverage, while Andrews, Kitagawa, and McCloskey study winner selection; neither profiles a causal target defined by exact zero-score donor faces.
body.consumer: CMS evaluators can report an ATT interval that remains valid when two or three comparison states are retained or replaced because of claims availability.
